style: Dark navy tech-precision stat hit for Danos Aparentes (vehicle damage inspection app). The number IS the message: a huge '5' counts up from 0 in well under a second while a sky-blue accent ring sweeps in sync, landing on '5 MIN' with a soft amber flash on impact. Everything holds calm and readable for the back half so the claim registers. Register: heavy geometric-sans impact (Montserrat 900) for the hero digit against a precise monospace (IBM Plex Mono) for the supporting line — impact vs. instrumentation, matching a product that turns a slow paper process into a fast, exact one.

customize.note: Evaluated registry block `apple-money-count` (npx hyperframes add) as the reuse-first candidate — landscape 1920x1080, light background, $-formatted money-burst motif, no ring primitive. Brief needs portrait 9:16, dark navy brand palette, a plain integer count (no currency), and a synced ring/arc sweep. Structural mismatch on aspect + theme + motif is too large to retrofit, so hand-authored per stat/module.md's alternate path (proven proxy-tween count-up + tabular-nums + hold pattern), reusing only the *technique* (GSAP proxy-object `onUpdate` count-up), not the block file.

typography.context_line: IBM Plex Mono 400, muted color, smallest

shot_brief: Black-navy frame, dead center: a ring track waits, empty. The instant the clip starts, the digit rockets 0→5 in ~0.9s while the sky-blue ring sweeps closed in lockstep — same easing, same finish frame, so eye and number land together. On landing (~1.05s) the ring flashes amber for one beat and the digit settles with a tiny scale-pop, 'MIN' fading in beside it as the unit. ~0.2s later the muted context line ('por vistoria completa — do toque à assinatura') fades up beneath. Everything then holds dead still for the last ~2s — no residual motion — so the claim is legible before the clip ends. One dominant motif (count-up + ring sync); the amber flash is the single pattern-interrupt beat.
